name: Projected Distinguishing Range of the Eluder--Range Separation Class
proof: The displayed class contains pairs differing only at each of the five coordinates: $(01111,11111)$, $(00111,01111)$, $(10000,10100)$, $(10000,10010)$, and $(01000,01001)$ respectively for $x_1,\ldots,x_5$. Hence every distinguishing coordinate set contains all five coordinates, so $\mathrm R(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{ER}})=5$. The full-domain projection is permitted in the maximum defining $\mathrm R^p$, while no projection has more than five coordinates; therefore $\mathrm R^p(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{ER}})=5$.
